title: K(pi,1) conjecture for Artin groups
exact_target: Is the standard Salvetti space for every finite-generator Artin group aspherical, so that it is a classifying space for that group?

sources.citation: G. Paolini, The K(pi,1) conjecture for Artin groups of spherical type, arXiv:2607.24659v1 (2026); R. Boyd, arXiv:2601.08658v1, Section 2.21.
